system.description: Advanced Move. When you call upon the spirits for safe passage through a natural danger, environment, or hazard, roll+WIS.

success.label: Success!
success.value:
The way is made safe, but choose one:
• It is only safe for you, not your allies or companions.
• It is safe for now, but not for long.
• The spirits demand a proportional payment or sacrifice in return.

partial.label: Partial Success
partial.value: The way is made safe, but choose two from the list.
